meta.title: Whale Girl · Working Beside You
meta.description: Your whale-girl buddy in the DSH window — she works beside you, waits with you, and cheers every win. Click her to open the session switcher and jump to any session (drag a list edge to resize it), right-click her for scope, size and nap timing, and drag her anywhere in the window. No model requests, nothing uploaded; preferences stay in local storage.
